aside.title: Participate, Volunteer, Make an Impact
aside.body: Register for college events, volunteer for certified hours, and book college facilities, all in one place.

help.password: At least 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
help.student_id: 6–12 digits, as shown on your student card.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Choose your account type, then enter your details.
login.remember_help: Keeps you signed in on this device for 30 days. Don't use it on a shared computer.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: A student account lets you register for events, volunteer and book facilities.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email is registered, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in :minutes minutes.
forgot.dev_hint: Development environment: emails aren't sent, they're saved locally.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. You'll be signed out on your other devices.
reset.invalid_link: This link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
reset.success: Password changed. Log in with your new password.

errors.failed: Email/student ID or password is incorrect.
errors.inactive: This account is deactivated. Contact the college administration.
errors.throttled: Too many login attempts. Try again in :minutes minutes.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Try again in an hour.
errors.register_throttled: Too many sign-up attempts from this network. Try again later.
errors.role_mismatch_admin: This account doesn't have admin access. Choose “Student” to log in.
errors.role_mismatch_student: This is an admin account. Choose “Admin” to log in.
